summary: Work Orders – Technicians Cannot Add Parts; "Save & Close" Does Nothing
reported_issue: Account-specific (Gearhead Mechanical). Technicians cannot add a part to a work order: opening the Add Part window and clicking Save & Close does nothing (the modal does not close and the part is not added). Only technician users are affected; the dev team was 'unable to reproduce locally'.
expected_after_fix: A technician (with add-parts permission) should be able to add a part via the Add Part window and have Save & Close persist the part and close the modal.
role_used: admin (add-part flow exercised); prior run also exercised the Technician role
steps_i_followed: Re-opened the add-part entry point as admin on WO S9-24075: Lines > New Line modal, which renders 'Save & Add Part', 'Save & Add Line', and 'Save & Close' (same controls prior testing confirmed are present/reachable for the Technician role).
Attempted to drive the flow to completion: fill the New Line, click 'Save & Add Part' to add a part and then exercise Save & Close persistence.
Observed the create/save behavior and network activity.
actual_now: The add-part UI (including Save & Close) is present and reachable, but I could not drive the New Line > Save & Add Part flow to a completed, persisted save within the harness this session: the 'What Are You Doing?' field is a canned-job combobox that validation-blocks free-typed values, so 'Save & Add Part'/'Save & Close' fired no create network request and the modal did not advance (same create-flow limitation seen across other create-* attempts). Because the save could not be completed even as admin, the tech-specific 'Save & Close does nothing' symptom could not be positively confirmed or denied. No product-side failure was directly observed; the buttons render and are enabled.
notes: Re-test of prior NEEDS-INFO. To close out: assign a role WITH add-parts permission to the Tech user (the client's technicians have add-parts enabled; stock org 'Technician' role has woAddParts=false), fresh Tech login, open a WO > Add Part, select a valid canned job for the line, add a part, click Save & Close and confirm the part persists and the modal closes. Blocker was the harness-flaky create/add-part combobox+save flow, not a confirmed product defect.
